title: The whole psalm is moral medicine
english: [[God spoke to the fathers by the prophets in many portions and many ways >> Bible:Hebrews 1:1]]. Sometimes the word unveils mysteries, sometimes the Savior’s coming, sometimes it heals conduct. Psalm 36 is wholly moral medicine. Its opening: [[Do not fret because of evildoers, nor envy those who work iniquity; for they will soon wither like grass >> Bible:Psalm 37:1-2]].

title: Aemulari means to provoke to jealousy
english: Here aemulari means to provoke jealousy. Deuteronomy: [[They made me jealous with what is no god; I will make them jealous >> Bible:Deuteronomy 32:21]]. Paul asks [[Are we provoking the Lord to jealousy? >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:22]]. [[The Lord your God is a jealous God >> Bible:Exodus 20:5]] — sin stokes that zeal.

title: Dwell in the land; delight in the Lord
english: [[Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and feed on its faithfulness >> Bible:Psalm 37:3]]. The “land” is the hearer’s heart — till the soul’s field. [[Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart >> Bible:Psalm 37:4]]. [[Commit your way to the Lord >> Bible:Psalm 37:5]]; he will [[bring forth your righteousness as the light >> Bible:Psalm 37:6]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
